title: Hosea Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Hosea 1: the word that came to Hosea, Gomer and her three children, and the names given to them.

questions.text: Hosea is called the son of whom in the opening verse?
questions.explanation: The chapter opens by saying that the word of Yahweh came to Hosea the son of Beeri.

answers.text: Joash
Diblaim
Beeri
Jotham

questions.text: Which king of Israel is named in the opening verse?
questions.explanation: The verse names Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, alongside the kings of Judah.

answers.text: Jeroboam the son of Joash
Ahaz the son of Jotham
Hezekiah the son of Ahaz
Uzziah the son of Jotham

questions.text: What was Hosea told to take for himself, and why?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Hosea to take a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness, because the land commits great adultery, forsaking Yahweh.

answers.text: A wife from the house of the king of Israel
A wife from among the daughters of Judah
A widow and her fatherless children
A wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness

questions.text: Whom did Hosea take, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The text says he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.

answers.text: Jezreel the daughter of Jehu
Gomer the daughter of Diblaim
Ruhamah the daughter of Beeri
Ammi the daughter of Joash

questions.text: What name was the first son to be given?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to call his name Jezreel, for in a little while he would avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu.

answers.text: Lo-Ammi
Lo-Ruhamah
Jezreel
Beeri

questions.text: What name was the daughter to be given, and what reason was stated?
questions.explanation: He was told to call her name Lo-Ruhamah, because Yahweh would no longer have mercy on the house of Israel.

answers.text: Lo-Ruhamah, for he would no longer have mercy on Israel
Jezreel, for the blood of Jezreel would be avenged
Lo-Ammi, for they were no longer his people
Gomer, for the land had committed adultery

questions.text: By what does Yahweh say he will not save the house of Judah?
questions.explanation: The verse says he will save the house of Judah by Yahweh their God, and not by bow, sword, battle, horses or horsemen.

answers.text: Not by priests, altars or sacrifices
Not by walls, gates or fortified cities
Not by treaties, tribute or gifts
Not by bow, sword, battle, horses or horsemen

questions.text: What name was the second son to be given?
questions.explanation: After Lo-Ruhamah was weaned she bore a son, and the name given was Lo-Ammi, with the words that you are not my people.

answers.text: Jehu
Lo-Ammi
Diblaim
Ruhamah

questions.text: What will the number of the children of Israel be like, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The text says the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or counted.

answers.text: As the stars of the sky
As the dust of the ground
As the sand of the sea
As the leaves of the forest

questions.text: What will the children of Judah and the children of Israel do, in the last verse?
questions.explanation: The verse says they will be gathered together, will appoint themselves one head, and will go up from the land, for great will be the day of Jezreel.

answers.text: Be gathered together and appoint themselves one head
Build an altar in the valley of Jezreel
Send tribute to the house of Jehu
Divide the land between their two kings
